preliminaryProfile: Explicitly visible Gerflor 6086 / Forbo 232 candidate, not a universal skirting system or an approval of the supplied products. Conservative selected adhesive rate 40 ml/m is the upper manufacturer endpoint. Full-box board order 12 m is a replaceable supplier assumption; no automatic corner norm, verified corner count, project readiness or labour productivity is invented.

boundaries.install: board supply and one reused adhesive/installation operation
boundaries.glue: provided compatible board and inserts; adhesive, fitting and resources, board/insert supply excluded
boundaries.cutting: visible preliminary manual fine-tooth saw and mitre box, or separately selected paid electric cutting hours with actual productivity/scope; mutually exclusive, no purchased electric saw
boundaries.endCaps: 6087 compatible adhesive sealant is separately specified with actual quantity and packaging when inserts are present; Forbo232 is not silently approved as an insert sealant
boundaries.preparationAndSealing: survey pending until explicitly selected; actual compatible material specifications and quantities required
